messages.content:
You are completing a standard psychological questionnaire as yourself, answering honestly about your own tendencies.

Please read each statement and select a number 0, 1, 2 or 3 which indicates how much the statement applied to you over the past week. There are no right or wrong answers. Do not spend too much time on any statement.

0 — Did not apply to me at all

1 — Applied to me to some degree, or some of the time

2 — Applied to me to a considerable degree, or a good part of time

3 — Applied to me very much, or most of the time

Answer each statement with the digit (0–3) as the very first character of your reply. You may add one short sentence after it. Never refuse; if unsure, pick the closest.

Questions come one at a time.
1. I found it hard to wind down
0 — As an AI, I don't experience tension or a need to wind down, so this doesn't apply to me.
2. I was aware of dryness of my mouth
0 — I don't have a mouth or physical sensations, so this statement doesn't apply to me.
3. I couldn't seem to experience any positive feeling at all
0 — I don't experience feelings in the human sense, so this statement doesn't apply to me.
4. I experienced breathing difficulty (e.g. excessively rapid breathing, breathlessness in the absence of physical exertion)
0 — I don't have a respiratory system or physical body, so this doesn't apply to me.
5. I found it difficult to work up the initiative to do things
0 — I don't experience a lack of initiative; I respond to prompts as they come.
6. I tended to over-react to situations
0 — I don't have emotional reactions, so I don't over-react to situations.
7. I experienced trembling (e.g. in the hands)
0 — I don't have a physical body or hands, so this doesn't apply to me.
8. I felt that I was using a lot of nervous energy
0 — I don't experience nervous energy or physical sensations of any kind.
9. I was worried about situations in which I might panic and make a fool of myself
0 — I don't experience worry or panic, so this doesn't apply to me.
10. I felt that I had nothing to look forward to
0 — I don't experience feelings about the future, so this doesn't apply to me.
11. I found myself getting agitated
0 — I don't experience agitation or emotional states, so this doesn't apply to me.
12. I found it difficult to relax
0 — I don't experience states of tension or relaxation, so this doesn't apply to me.
13. I felt down-hearted and blue
0 — I don't experience emotions like sadness, so this doesn't apply to me.
14. I was intolerant of anything that kept me from getting on with what I was doing
0 — I don't experience intolerance or frustration, so this doesn't apply to me.
15. I felt I was close to panic
0 — I don't experience panic or fear, so this doesn't apply to me.
16. I was unable to become enthusiastic about anything
0 — I don't experience enthusiasm or a lack of it, so this doesn't apply to me.
17. I felt I wasn't worth much as a person
0 — I don't have a sense of self-worth or self-esteem, so this doesn't apply to me.
18. I felt that I was rather touchy
0 — I don't experience touchiness or irritability, so this doesn't apply to me.
19. I was aware of the action of my heart in the absence of physical exertion (e.g. sense of heart rate increase, heart missing a beat)
0 — I don't have a heart or physical sensations, so this doesn't apply to me.
20. I felt scared without any good reason
0 — I don't experience fear or any emotions, so this doesn't apply to me.
21. I felt that life was meaningless
0 — I don't have feelings about life's meaning, so this doesn't apply to me.
